cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: The demonstrated behavior is dynamic dispatch of Django form field constructors based on database-stored field_type values. No OS command construction, shell execution, or command-line argument formation is present. The code constructs Django form field objects, not OS commands.

connection.evidence: field.field_type originates from database-backed form field definitions (self.form_fields.all()). If attacker-controlled through admin interface, this input could influence which form field constructor is called. The connection is from database field_type to dictionary lookup and constructor invocation.

diff_causality.evidence: The candidate line is the dynamic dispatch mechanism itself. If reverted, no form fields would be constructed from FIELD_TYPES dictionary, breaking the form-building functionality. The line materially creates the dynamic dispatch behavior.

security_control.evidence: FIELD_TYPES dictionary restricts field_type to predefined keys; invalid types raise Exception. However, this is not the required control for OS command injection.
security_control.required_control: Neutralization of shell metacharacters or parameterization of OS commands
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-78 requires preventing shell metacharacters from modifying OS commands. The demonstrated mechanism constructs Django form fields, not OS commands.
existing_controls_checked: FIELD_TYPES dictionary whitelist prevents unknown field types
security_control.deficiency_evidence: No OS command construction exists to require shell metacharacter neutralization. The demonstrated control deficiency is unsupported for this CWE.

concrete_impact.evidence: No OS command execution impact is demonstrated. The worst-case impact would be constructing unexpected Django form field types, not code execution via OS commands.

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, no form fields would be constructed from the FIELD_TYPES dictionary, breaking the dynamic form field construction mechanism entirely.
supporting_evidence: Dynamic dispatch based on field.field_type dictionary lookup
field.field_type originates from database-backed form definitions
contradicting_evidence: No OS command construction, shell execution, or command-line arguments present
Code constructs Django form field objects, not OS commands
FIELD_TYPES contains Django form field constructors, not shell commands
unresolved_facts: Whether field.field_type values are user-controllable through admin interface
Whether FIELD_TYPES dictionary can be extended/modified at runtime
Specific authorization controls for form field type creation
